verdict.rationale: Docs describe a URL-to-content endpoint that can convert any URL into HTML, JSON, or markdown, directly supporting single-call scraping with raw HTML output, but this is framed as 'fetch web context' rather than a dedicated documented scrape API with clear parameters/examples. Missing for 10: explicit API reference/example showing a single call returning raw HTML, independent hands-on verification of output fidelity, and confirmation of an OpenAPI spec (openapi probe returned 404s).
